notes.title: 📢 Incoming Transmission from Resistance HQ...
notes.content:
Recruits! Resistance Command has deployed a critical update. Whether you're climbing the leaderboards or sharpening your skills in the field, v0.4.3 brings new tech, improved visuals, and vital fixes based on community intel.

🆕 New Features 
Custom Leaderboard Names (LBE Only): Operators in Location-Based Entertainment mode can now enter custom leaderboard names—no more Steam handles on display. (Note: Not available for home use.)

⚙ Improvements from Engineering Corps
RPG Overhaul:
    Projectile impacts now respect line of sight.
    Damage scales with distance from the blast centre.Hitscan Visuals:
    Bullet trails now properly reflect the instant-hit nature of your weapons.Updated Game Description:
    Clearer comms! The game now explicitly states it's designed for stationary play.Laser Sight Upgrade:
    Every weapon now includes a laser pointer.
    A laser dot has been added for better aiming precision.
🗺 Map Changes & Base Upgrades
Visual Clarity:
    Outline shader tweaks improve visibility across all maps.Alpha Base Environmental Update:
    Made a minor visual tweak to background props to enhance immersion—keen-eyed recruits may spot the difference.Bravo Base Adjustments:
    Starting tower walls lowered for clearer sightlines.
    Excessive lighting removed to reduce glare on sniper scopes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333749/d74f408e89157fe15ddf2d91bcee36d88202c966.png
🐞 Bug Fixes from Tech SupportExecutable Name:
    File now properly named “Warranty Not Included.exe.”Leaderboard Ranks:
    Fixed issue where retries showed incorrect placement.Zero Score Reporting:
    You’ll now be listed as “Unrankable” if no targets were hit, instead of showing an arbitrary rank.RPG Collision & Reloading:
    Impact detection fixed across all bases.
    RPGs can no longer fire before finishing reload.
⚖ Balance Changes – Weapon Division Report
Shotgun Reload Speed:
    This underrated beast is now faster and deadlier.
        Previous Reload Time: 5.000 seconds
        New Reload Time: 3.383 secondsThat’s over 32.34% faster—give it another go and rain shells like a pro.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333749/8453689315ec68e2513cc2ca6d17ecccf451128f.gif
⚠ Known Issues (On the Radar)
Leaderboard UI Lock-Up:
    Minimising the leaderboard can cause it to freeze. If this happens, a restart is required.
    Status: Under investigation—UI overhaul in the works!
💬 From the Frontline – Community Intel
Thanks to all of you reporting bugs, sharing strategies, and helping us improve the game. Your feedback is powering the resistance!

Want to help shape future updates?
🔗 Join the fight on Discord and Steam!

🪖 Stay sharp, soldier. The resistance is counting on you.
- Boss Johnson

notes.title: Warranty Not Included is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
What is Warranty Not Included?
It’s a thrilling VR shooter that combines skill, precision, and action-packed fun. With a variety of weapons and challenging gun ranges, this game is perfect for both casual and hardcore VR enthusiasts.

[previewyoutube=grAtMwtL1-0;full][/previewyoutube]

3 Unique Training Grounds:
Each training ground brings its own twist to the challenge—be it location, environment, or game mode.

 Alpha Base: A desert-themed firing range with 24 randomised pop-up targets. Ideal for sharpening your reflexes.
 Bravo Base: An indoor range with elevation challenges that test your vertical and horizontal tracking.
 Charlie Base: A skeet-shooting-inspired outdoor range near an active airfield. Track and shoot moving targets across a semicircular course of 24.

7 Distinct Weapons:
Each weapon features unique handling, animations, and audio. Which will be your favourite?

 Pistol: M1911
 SMG: MP9
 Assault Rifle: AR-15
 Light Machine Gun: M249
 Shotgun: SPAZ-12
 Sniper Rifle: L96A1
 RPG: Because who doesn’t love a good explosion?

Climb the Online Leaderboards:
Compete with players worldwide! Each recruit can battle for the top spot on the global leaderboards for each weapon and training ground. Can you become the ultimate #1 Recruit?

Warranty Not Included is available to purchase now on Steam!
